name: GFED Global Fire Emissions Database (GFED4s)
description: The Global Fire Emissions Database (GFED, Version 4s) combines satellite-derived burned area observations from MODIS with the Carnegie-Ames-Stanford Approach (CASA) biogeochemical model to quantify monthly global fire activity and trace gas emissions from 1997 to the present at 0.25° resolution. GFED4s incorporates small fire burn estimates based on active fire detections, delivering gridded dry matter emissions and emission factors for carbon dioxide (CO2), carbon monoxide (CO), methane (CH4), black carbon (BC), organic carbon (OC), and PM2.5 partitioned across six fire types.
